errors.text_span: Die Balken sind nicht hervorgehoben oder anders visuell markiert
errors.evidence: The machine description states that the bars are not visually marked, but the colors (blue, violet, gray) clearly distinguish the years.
The machine description does not mention that the chart represents the share of Russian imports of industrial raw materials.
The machine description does not mention that the vertical axis is scaled in increments of 5.
The machine description does not specify that the horizontal axis is divided into three categories: Aluminium, Kupfer, and Nickel.
